The Method

A connected path to AI client acquisition.

We bridge the gap between traditional website SEO and the generative answer engines your buyers now consult before shortlisting providers.

01 / DISCOVERY

Get Retrieved Without Noise

AI engines cannot cite what they cannot reliably parse. We publish lightweight machine-readable manifests (/llms.txt, AI crawler directives, and JSON-LD entity graphs) that give bots unambiguous access to your offerings, credentials, and geographic footprint.

Foundation: Manifests & Crawler Directives
02 / AUTHORITY

Earn Direct Answer Citations

When buyers ask comparison questions, LLMs pull from succinct, verifiable 40–55 word declarative paragraphs. We engineer passage-level answer architecture and comparative proof matrices that answer engines quote word-for-word.

Architecture: Passage-Level Direct Answers
03 / ACQUISITION

Turn Recommendations Into Leads

AI visibility is meaningless if it does not convert. We automate daily staging directly into your existing CMS (WordPress, Shopify, or GitHub repo) with human-in-the-loop review, turning citation momentum into qualified commercial inbound enquiries.

Delivery: Automated 1-Click Staging
Editorial Principle
"No reputable agency can guarantee a #1 ranking in ChatGPT. Here is what we do instead."

AI answers vary dynamically by user location, prompt phrasing, conversational history, and continuous model recalibration. Anyone promising a "guaranteed ChatGPT top spot" is selling false promises.

At Answer Index, we do not game algorithms. We engineer verifiable machine-readable ground truth. When an AI search engine synthesizes a category recommendation, it prioritizes sources with unambiguous schemas, verified passage answers, and zero data conflict. We make your business the safest, most authoritative answer to retrieve.

Questions & Answers

Practical, clear guidance.

What is the difference between AEO and traditional SEO?
Traditional SEO optimizes for keyword rank positions across lists of hyperlinks. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) structures your core business entities, proofs, and answers so conversational LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) directly synthesize and recommend your business to buyers.
What is /llms.txt and why is it necessary?
/llms.txt is the emerging web standard for AI crawlers. Much like robots.txt tells web crawlers where to look, /llms.txt delivers a curated, clean Markdown index of your core business facts, avoiding token bloat and hallucination.
Does Answer Index require replacing my existing website or CMS?
No. Answer Index works with your existing architecture (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Next.js, or custom static sites). Deliverables are staged as review drafts or GitHub pull requests with 100% human-in-the-loop review before publishing.
How quickly do AI answer engines pick up these changes?
Generative engines that browse the live web (Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews) ingest and reflect structured manifests within days. Base model training datasets reflect updates during periodic model releases.
